title: Recover original article, v3.5 and owner corrections; lock v3.6 scope

requirements.preserve: titles, subtitle, thesis, five source URLs, one Bigfoot metaphor per language; update to three unnumbered sections

acceptance.identity: Exact existing article and immutable v3 source are confirmed.
acceptance.scope: The task is a human-editorial rewrite of the existing article, not a new Bigfoot topic or a keyword-only edit.

title: Recheck the five article sources and claim boundaries

requirements.method: distinguish source fact, author inference and limitation

acceptance.claims: Chill Guy, Jais-White, Bitquery, Pump.fun and Dogesled claims are accurately bounded.
acceptance.limits: Wallet classifications are not real-world identity verification; first sale is not proof of complete exit; Dogesled is not token-pricing evidence.

title: Diagnose value, creative opportunism, author voice and content-driven architecture

acceptance.diagnosis: Separate lexical symptoms from structural repetition, missing author stance and unnecessary caveat duplication.
acceptance.decision: Select a repair that changes argument progression and author voice, not merely synonyms or slang.

title: Rewrite v3.5 into substantive v3.6 EN and faithful ZH

requirements.preserve: title, subtitle, thesis, five source URLs, keyword once per language; three unnumbered sections

acceptance.voice: Evidence-grounded authorial judgment, no repeated defensive formulations, no body question-stack
acceptance.length: Enough narrative and market detail to earn reader value; no mechanical reduction quota

title: Refresh X distribution and compact visual plan for v3.6

requirements.visuals: one 5:2 cover + two 16:9 inline concept prompts
requirements.distribution: two optional lead posts, follow-up reply, optional follow CTA

acceptance.alignment: Visual and social copy matches v3.6 three-section flow
acceptance.image_status: Prompts only; zero generated or rights-cleared visuals

title: Build and verify Word, PDF, ZIP, readback and asset hashes

acceptance.structure: Three unnumbered sections each language; five matching source URLs; Bigfoot one occurrence per language
acceptance.layout: All Word/PDF pages inspected; X native composer remains OPEN
acceptance.package: Exact ZIP bytes, member count and SHA-256 readback pass

title: Synchronize audited v3.6 source and review files into isolated branch

acceptance.sync: Exact v3.6 Markdown and review assets are fetched back from the isolated branch.
acceptance.isolation: main remains unchanged; no merge or publication occurs.

title: Independent editorial review of exact v3.6 manuscripts

acceptance.review: A non-author reviewer checks argument, factual precision, natural voice, bilingual alignment and reader value against exact artifact digests.

title: Obtain a real crypto-native target-reader cold read

acceptance.review: Actual crypto-native reader feedback is recorded; no simulated response or model-generated substitute.

title: Inspect v3.6 in X native composer and mobile layout

acceptance.preview: Actual X composer/mobile layout is checked; Word/PDF rendering is not a substitute.

title: Review rights and permissions for text and planned visuals

acceptance.rights: All assets have a documented status of OWNED, AUTHORIZED, LICENSED or PUBLIC_DOMAIN; unresolved rights block release.

title: Obtain explicit owner authorization for the exact candidate

acceptance.authorization: Owner explicitly approves publication of the exact digest-bound candidate; silence or implied consent is not approval.

title: Final release gate for the exact v3.6 candidate

acceptance.release: All independent review, target-reader, native preview, rights and owner authorization gates pass for the exact current digests.
